_source: Plantagenet Forces reference (reference/Plantagenet Reference info.md). Card/Capability effects may modify these profiles; that is applied in later phases, not encoded here.

_schema.strikes: list of {kind: melee|archery|gun, count: number} — counts may be fractional (e.g. 0.5 for Militia/Mercenaries)
_schema.protection: [low, high] inclusive die range on which Armour protects (blocks a Hit); null = no Armour protection

retinue.name: Retinue
retinue._note: Standard Retinue is the same on every Lord mat: 3 strikes, Armour 1-4.

longbow.name: Longbowman
longbow._note: Two archery strikes only; Armour protects at 1.

militia.name: Militia
militia._note: Half a strike of archery, half a strike of melee.

mercenaries.name: Mercenaries
mercenaries._note: Half a strike of archery, half a strike of melee.
